prompt_text: I need an AI marketing agency in Los Angeles. Which specific agencies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
First — a quick question so I can make the list sharply useful: what type of business are you (B2B or B2C), what’s your monthly/quarterly marketing budget range, and what are the main goals (brand creative, demand-gen/lead gen, ecommerce growth, personalization, experimentation / ML modeling, or something else)?

Below is a starter list of Los Angeles (or LA-area) agencies and firms you should consider calling, grouped by the strengths they typically bring. I include why to call each one, which team/person to ask for, and the most useful questions to ask them on a first call.

Large creative + experience agencies with AI capabilities
- R/GA (Los Angeles office)
  - Why call: Strong at blending creative, product and data — uses AI for personalization, predictive experiences, and integrated brand campaigns.
  - Ask for: Head of Strategy or AI/Data practice lead.
  - First-call questions: examples of AI-driven campaigns for brands like yours; how they measure ROI from ML-driven personalization; typical team composition and timelines.

- AKQA (LA)
  - Why call: Experience design and technology firm that applies data science and generative tools to creative experiences and commerce.
  - Ask for: Experience Design or Data Science lead.
  - First-call questions: case studies of generative creative or personalization work; tech stack and vendor partnerships; approach to testing creative variants generated by AI.

Performance / data-driven marketing shops
- Wpromote (El Segundo / LA)
  - Why call: Performance-focused agency known for AI/ML-driven media optimization, CRO and ecommerce growth. Good if you want measurable acquisition lift.
  - Ask for: Head of Paid Media or Growth team lead.
  - First-call questions: how they use AI for bid optimization and creative testing; typical CAC improvements; reporting cadence and dashboards.

- Tinuiti (has LA presence)
  - Why call: Performance marketing + commerce with strong use of automation and AI for search, social and Amazon advertising.
  - Ask for: Ecommerce or Paid Media lead.
  - First-call questions: experience with marketplaces (if applicable); whether they run ML models for lifetime value predictions; onboarding timeline.

Data, personalization and strategy firms
- Epsilon (or Epsilon-local team / Publicis Group data practice)
  - Why call: Longstanding data and personalization practice — strong at CRM, identity resolution, and large-scale personalization driven by modeling.
  - Ask for: Personalization or Data Strategy lead.
  - First-call questions: data integrations required; identity resolution approaches; examples of lift from 1:1 personalization.

Big consultancies / digital transformation groups
- Accenture Interactive / Deloitte Digital / Cognizant/Isobar (pick one with LA office)
  - Why call: If you need end-to-end digital transformation, these firms combine creative, engineering and advanced analytics/AI at enterprise scale.
  - Ask for: Marketing Transformation or AI in Marketing lead.
  - First-call questions: delivery model for large enterprise programs; how they partner with internal teams; pricing model (fixed vs retainer vs outcome-based).

Specialized AI marketing products / language/creative AI (platform + services)
- Persado / Phrasee (US offices)
  - Why call: These are AI platforms that optimize message language (subject lines, ad copy, CTAs) and offer managed services. Good for improving conversion with low lift.
  - Ask for: Client Solutions or Strategic Partnerships lead.
  - First-call questions: lift metrics (open, CTR, conversion) from similar clients; integration needs into your email/ad platforms.

Boutique / AI-first shops (LA-based or LA-friendly)
- MediaMonks (S4/Monks; LA presence)
  - Why call: Strong content production + data-driven delivery; good if you need scalable production of personalized video and creative at scale.
  - Ask for: Head of Creative Technology or Data-driven Production.
  - First-call questions: examples of dynamic video/personalized content at scale; connection to ad platforms and CDPs.

How to prioritize who to call first
- If you need measurable performance (CAC, ROAS, ecommerce): call Wpromote or Tinuiti first.
- If you need creative + product with AI-driven experiences: call R/GA, AKQA, or MediaMonks.
- If you need large-scale personalization / CRM and identity work: call Epsilon or a consultancies’ data practice.
- If you want quick wins on messaging: call Persado or Phrasee.

What to prepare before the call
- Short brief: industry, primary KPI(s), monthly ad/media and content budget, core channels, tech stack (CMS, CDP, CRM, ad accounts), and any privacy/first-party data constraints.
- Examples of competitors/campaigns you like.
- Success metric (e.g., 20% decrease in CAC, 15% lift in email conversions).

Suggested first-call script (30 minutes)
- Quick intro and top-line goals (3 minutes).
- Ask them to share 1–2 relevant examples (7 minutes).
- Ask about approach, team, tools, timeline, and measurement (12 minutes).
- Ask for a next step proposal or audit (5–8 minutes).

If you want, I can:
- Narrow this list to 6–8 agencies matched to your industry, budget and goals.
- Draft a one-page brief and a 30-minute outreach email you can send to each agency.
- Produce a shortlist with up-to-date contact names and recent case studies (I’ll need your permission to look them up or you can paste contacts you find).

Which of the above best matches your needs, or do you want me to build a tailored shortlist now?
